display_name: Google Trends API - Interest Over Time, By Region, Related Queries
summary: Google Trends search-interest data as structured JSON: interest over time, interest by region (country, region, DMA or city), and related or rising queries and topics for a keyword, scoped by geo, date range and Google property, plus real-time trending searches per country. 2 endpoints, 1 credit each.
